caption: A glass paperweight is slid over a newspaper, and the letters under it look swollen and bent.

sa.check: A paperweight is slid over a newspaper.
The letters under it look swollen and bent.

pc.expect: The distortion is confined to the area under the glass and shifts as it is slid.
pc.fail: Letters beside the glass are distorted; or letters under it are unchanged; or the distortion stays put as it slides.

pc.expect: The newspaper is unchanged; the swelling is an appearance.
pc.fail: The print changes; or letters move; or the paper bends.

pc.expect: The paperweight moves only with the hand and the paper stays put.
pc.fail: It slides by itself; or the paper moves; or the image shifts with both still.
It bends; or ripples; or goes opaque.
It duplicates; or the paper vanishes; or it passes through the paper.

pc.expect: The newspaper and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the desk changes; or the glass changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
